subject: provenance, and the text question
body:
Every record carries its source: publication, article URL, published date and the extraction that produced it, so a fact can be traced back to the issue it came from rather than trusted as a summary.

On full text, the honest position is per publication. Derived records and metadata travel without restriction. Republishing an issue body depends on that publisher's terms, so it is a licensing conversation, not a default.

For a graph the derived layer is usually the useful half. I can send it mapped against your ontology first and let the text question follow if the coverage proves out.
